cell_type.evidence: inferred: The osmotic-stress-activated plant Ca<sup>2+</sup>-dependent protein kinases (CPKs), the mammalian Ca<sup>2+</sup>/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase II delta (CAMK2D) and TANK-binding kinase 1 (TBK1) phosphorylate TIR domains at this conserved serine, which blocks TIR NADase activities and functions, thereby maintaining growth in plants and suppressing SARM1 TIR signalling in animals.
